messages:
Jules Tran: Quick sync — VectorCloud + Redwood co-sell POC for NimbusCorp. Need a short runbook + blockers list. Priority: SSO, data residency, pricing ask. Legal wants the security questionnaire answered this week. Who can own the runbook?
Samir Patel: I can own the runbook. Quick notes: NimbusCorp expects Dedicated GPU (1xA100) + VPC peering. Need an estimate of token volume to size appropriately. @Priya Kaur can you confirm SOC2 status and data residency options? Also — any promo/credits we can offer to keep momentum? :thinking_face:
Priya Kaur: Working on the sec questionnaire — I uploaded the infosec spreadsheet to the partner folder and pinged them for missing items. Missing right now: third-party pen-test report and explicit encryption-at-rest KMS details. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec-uploads/nimbus-poc (internal). ETA: EOD Thu.
Marco Li: Pricing idea for a 2-week shared POC with 1xA100 dedicated: `POC flat fee = $6,000 + $0.0008/token overage` (subject to change). Can we offer a $3k credit to reduce friction? cc @Jules Tran.
Samir Patel: Draft runbook checklist (will flesh out into a doc):
```
1) Kickoff: joint arch walk (Redwood + VectorCloud + Nimbus)
2) Confirm SSO/SAML flow + test account
3) Set up VPC peering & route table checks
4) Deploy model v1 -> smoke test (sample prompts)
5) Perf run: target 50 RPS, 99th pct latency < 250ms for 512 tokens
6) Collect token/cost logs, share cost-estimate report
7) Wrap + decision criteria for next steps
```
Ari (VectorCloud): We can own the SSO integration on our side, but Nimbus legal needs an IP protection clause and our DPA addendum signed. Can Redwood sign VectorCloud's DPA addendum? I'll drop our legal contact: rmcdonald@vectorcloud.com.
Priya Kaur: We can sign a partner DPA addendum — need their template. Send it to privacy@redwood.com. Note on KMS: customer-managed keys are available for Private deployments; for Hosted we currently do envelope encryption with provider KMS. I'll add language to the questionnaire.
Jules Tran: Action items summary: @Samir Patel = runbook + perf targets; @Marco Li = pricing proposal + credit ask; @Priya Kaur = finish sec questionnaire + route DPA to privacy; @Ari (VectorCloud) = send legal template + confirm SSO contact. Proposed kickoff: Thu 10:00am PT. I'll send the calendar invite if everyone OK.
Ari (VectorCloud): 10:00am PT works for us.
Marco Li: I'll try to get approval for the $3k credit from Finance — pinging them now. @Eve (bot) can you create a ticket for the POC PRD? :pray:
Eve (bot): PRD ticket created: #RD-5421 — https://redwood.internal/tasks/RD-5421
Samir Patel: Thanks — I'll draft the runbook doc and post it here by EOD today.
Jules Tran: Perfect. If anything else pops up (legal questions or network diagrams), drop them here and I'll triage. :thumbsup:
